messages:
maya: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a 'sparse-run' coordinator for PR evals in GH Actions to cut runner churn. Idea: only spin up full eval runners when a PR touches model code or we detect a semantic model-diff label. Otherwise reuse warm artifacts and run a tiny smoke job.

sam: Sounds promising. Will this change PR gating latency? tagging @liam to check impact on our PR gate SLOs.

liam: Quick note on intended gating logic: if PR has 'model-diff' label OR files match 'models/**' then we trigger full-matrix. Otherwise run lightweight smoke and optional quant-smoke. Example condition in the workflow: 
```
if: contains(join(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, ','), 'model-diff') || contains(github.event.pull_request.changed_files, 'models/')
```
This should keep most infra cheap.

maya: also adding a ~30s smoke job on every PR that runs core evals against a cached prefix and checks our top-3 metrics for regressions. If smoke fails, escalate to full-matrix.

deploy-bot: buildkite: queued job 'pr-eval-smoke' on prod-runners-1 (id: bk-98321) :rocket:

sam: one concern: artifact reuse TTL. If we reuse artifacts older than 12h we might miss cascade regressions (e.g., quantization patches). Recommend TTL=6h for reuse by default, with an override in repo config. Also would like a short grafana panel for 'PR eval wait time' + 'runner reuse hit rate'.

maya: agreed. I'll add config flag `eval_runner.reuse_artifact_ttl_hours: 6` and a repo-level override. Will open a PR with GH workflow changes + docs. tagging @eng-sre for quota/runner impact review.

liam: :thumbsup: please include an integration test for the workflow matrix so we don't accidentally bypass required checks.

eng-sre: noted — we'll watch quota metrics once it's live and pre-warm a small warm pool if reuse rate spikes.

maya: PR will land tomorrow morning, link back when opened. Thanks all. :sparkles:
